remarks: Also listed under condo/Twhs b1713385. Here it is, the Patio Home you've been waiting for! This 3 Bed, 2 Full Bath, Ranch style Patio Home is conveniently located in the Parker Commons Community & offers a delightful view of the Association's large pond with fountain. You'll appreciate the professionally landscaped front w/a covered front porch perfect for you to sit back & relax. The spacious Foyer w/coat closet offers a panoramic view of the wonderfully Open Floor Plan that you'll just love. The Living Room/Great Room has a tray ceiling with inset lighting & a convenient gas fireplace for you to enjoy. The gorgeous Kitchen has a breakfast bar & an extensive amount of cabinets & countertops that all cooks will appreciate. All appliances stay too! The Dining space is surrounded by windows on all sides, offering you views of your treed & private backyard. The Primary Bedroom located in the back of the unit with tray ceiling has an ensuite bath w/a step-in shower & linen closet. A very spacious walk-in closet finishes out the suite. The second Bedroom located in the front of the unit has a double closet & a pocket door for private access to the second full bath with step-in shower. The third Bedroom also has a double closet and the current owner was utilizing this room as a home office. Rounding out the main floor is the "oh so convenient" First Floor Laundry! The basement w/glass block windows and sump pump is huge, offering endless possibilities. Utilize it for storage, a home gym, handyman workspace or finish it off to your own specifications. There is a cement, covered, backyard patio too...perfect space to enjoy your coffee while appreciating the natural surroundings. The attached 2 car garage is a plus too! The HOA fee includes: water, garbage pick-up, lawn cutting & fertilizing, front yard landscape beds, snow removal right to your front door, alarm monitoring and availability to use the Clubhouse for entertaining. There is also a fire sprinkler system & whole house generator for added peace of mind. This is truly a special unit...one you'd be proud to call your Home! Seller reserves the right to set an offer deadline.
